tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for information the workspace cannot answer: current events, library versions and release notes, error messages, docs pages. Returns ranked results (title, URL, snippet); follow up with web_fetch on the 1-2 most relevant URLs for the full text. query is the search string — engine syntax like quoted phrases, site: and -term filters work; short factual queries beat long sentences. max_results caps entries (default $config.web_search_max_results). Backends available on this machine ($backends) are tried in order — the first that returns results wins; when all fail the error lists each backend's reason, and backend=<name> pins one.

query.description: search string (engine syntax like site: and quoted phrases works)

backend.description: pin one backend: $backends (default: fall through the chain)

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a web page by URL and return its readable text (title + body; scripts, styles and site chrome stripped). HTML pages and raw text/JSON responses both work; binary types are refused. max_chars caps the returned text (default $config.read_max_chars) and start skips ahead in characters — when content is truncated the tail note gives the exact next start value. Non-public hosts (localhost, LAN IPs) are refused. Prefer 1-2 targeted fetches over many: search first with web_search, then fetch only the promising URLs.

max_chars.description: max chars of extracted text to return (default $config.read_max_chars)

start.description: 0-based char offset to continue a truncated fetch
